feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.reason: The PR deletes the 'Caching' describe block (should cache authorization/filter conditions) from insightsBooking.integration-test.ts, while the memoization in insightsBooking.ts:83-95 is kept essentially unchanged. Real coverage loss, but for trivial memoization logic the PR did not alter.
feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.comment: The caching tests for getAuthorizationConditions/getFilterConditions were removed in the Prisma.sql conversion, leaving the cached-condition logic untested.

feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.reason: getBaseConditions (insightsBooking.ts:68-80) does return authConditions/filterConditions unwrapped, and these can be top-level OR fragments (lines 106, 173, 206). But the only consumer at head (integration test :480-484) uses it alone as `WHERE ${baseConditions}`; no code path appends another predicate, so the precedence leak cannot occur.
feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.comment: Claims getBaseConditions returns OR fragments without parentheses, so a caller appending `AND <extra>` would leak rows outside the authorization scope.

feat-ecosystem-implement-cross-system-is.reason: The PR adds `assignment_source` to the abstract sync_status_outbound signature (mixins/issues.py:411-418), but tasks/sync_status_outbound.py:41-44 never passes it and no should_sync('outbound_status', ...) uses it, so it is a dead parameter. The status sync path itself is untouched by the PR, so any status loop is pre-existing; the real issue is the misleading unused parameter.
feat-ecosystem-implement-cross-system-is.comment: sync_status_outbound gains an assignment_source parameter that is never threaded through the status task or checked in should_sync, so status sync gets no cycle prevention despite the signature suggesting it.

feat-uptime-add-ability-to-use-queues-to.reason: In get_committable_offsets (queue_consumer.py:89-93) the loop breaks at the first offset that is not in all_offsets or still outstanding, so it never walks a gap; work is bounded by the contiguous run of tracked offsets, not by max_offset - start.
feat-uptime-add-ability-to-use-queues-to.comment: Claims the committable-offset loop iterates the whole numeric span max_offset - start, burning CPU on large offset gaps every commit cycle.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.reason: The new EmbeddableHost model (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2) validates hosts with `\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?`, rejecting TLDs longer than five letters such as .technology or .photography. The previous SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? did plain string comparison with no format restriction.
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.comment: EmbeddableHost's host format validation only accepts TLDs of 2-5 letters, so admins cannot add embeddable hosts on longer TLDs like example.technology.

feature-localization-fallbacks-server-si.reason: config/initializers/i18n.rb:24 unconditionally assigns `I18n.fallbacks = FallbackLocaleList.new`, which defines ensure_loaded! (:20-22), and nothing else in app/lib/config reassigns I18n.fallbacks. The guard requested covers a state no code path reaches.
feature-localization-fallbacks-server-si.comment: Claims set_locale's `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` (application_controller.rb:159) raises NoMethodError on every request if I18n.fallbacks is not the custom FallbackLocaleList.

fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.reason: selectedCalendar is now `destinationCalendar?.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` (CalendarService.ts:147-149), which can be undefined; the insert falls back to "primary" (:154) but the follow-up events.patch passes `calendarId: selectedCalendar` (:168) raw. Before the PR selectedCalendar already defaulted to "primary", so the PR introduces the undefined calendarId.
fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.comment: In Google createEvent, when no destination calendar matches the credentialId, the hangout-link events.patch is called with an undefined calendarId and fails, so the Meet link is not added to the event description.

github-oauth-security-enhancement-sentry.reason: OAuthLoginView posts code/client_id/client_secret without redirect_uri (github/integration.py:416-420), but GitHub's token endpoint treats redirect_uri as optional and only rejects a mismatching value when one is sent. The claimed redirect_uri_mismatch on every installation does not occur.
github-oauth-security-enhancement-sentry.comment: Claims the GitHub OAuth token exchange omits redirect_uri, so GitHub returns redirect_uri_mismatch and every installation fails.

github-oauth-security-enhancement-sentry.reason: Nothing at head sends installation_id='null', and even if it did, Integration.objects.get(external_id='null') raising DoesNotExist goes to `return pipeline.next_step()` (github/integration.py:476-477), not to the 'Invalid installation request.' error page the comment describes.
github-oauth-security-enhancement-sentry.comment: Claims a literal 'null' installation_id passes the None check and routes users to the 'Invalid installation request.' page instead of the app installer.

implement-recovery-key-support-for-user-.reason: The new getCredentials in BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.java:231-235 dereferences myUser from getMyUser (:226-228, a plain map lookup) without the null check that isConfiguredFor (:271) and isValid (:286) have. It only fails for a user missing from the map in this testsuite provider (not on every call), so it is a defensive inconsistency in test code.
implement-recovery-key-support-for-user-.comment: BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.getCredentials dereferences getMyUser(user) without a null check, so it throws NullPointerException for a user missing from the provider's map.

optimize-spans-buffer-insertion-with-evi.reason: ZUNIONSTORE returns the cardinality of the resulting destination set, which is exactly the total size of set_key after the merge (add-buffer.lua:47,53). zpopmin(set_key, span_count - 1000) (:62-63) therefore trims to exactly 1000, and the proposed zcard(set_key) gives the same number.
optimize-spans-buffer-insertion-with-evi.comment: Claims span_count counts pre-existing spans in set_key, so zpopmin evicts far more than the overflow above 1000 and discards valid spans.

replays-self-serve-bulk-delete-system-se.reason: _truncate_title is a @staticmethod defined inside PRCommentWorkflow (commit_context.py:494 class, :577-582 method), not on CommitContextIntegration, so PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(title) at :601 resolves correctly.
replays-self-serve-bulk-delete-system-se.comment: Claims _truncate_title is defined on CommitContextIntegration, so PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title raises AttributeError.

unified-storage-performance-optimization.reason: backend.WatchWriteEvents (sql/backend.go:558-567) starts a separate poller and channel for each caller, so search.init's stream (search.go:203) and initWatcher's stream (server.go:755) are independent; the search reader cannot consume the broadcaster's events. Init now also runs inside NewResourceServer (server.go:258) before any Watch subscriber can exist.
unified-storage-performance-optimization.comment: Claims write events arriving between search watcher start and initWatcher are consumed by the search reader and never reach Watch subscribers.
